svg.title: tsrs vs bun check vs tsgo
svg.desc: Summed over 17 TypeScript projects · 4 threads each · 16-vCPU Linux machine. Check time: tsrs 12.5 s, bun check 37.6 s, tsgo 82.3 s. Peak memory: tsrs 12.6 GiB, bun check 15.4 GiB, tsgo 53.3 GiB. Shorter is better. Per project: vscode: tsrs 2.41 s, 1.80 GiB; bun check 4.94 s, 1.50 GiB; tsgo 11.57 s, 7.52 GiB. xstate-main: tsrs 0.16 s, 0.25 GiB; bun check 0.30 s, 0.30 GiB; tsgo 0.85 s, 0.72 GiB. webpack: tsrs 0.29 s, 0.39 GiB; bun check 0.55 s, 0.36 GiB; tsgo 1.48 s, 1.15 GiB. mui-docs: tsrs 1.02 s, 1.05 GiB; bun check 9.28 s, 5.38 GiB; tsgo 12.41 s, 7.53 GiB. Compiler: tsrs 0.07 s, 0.09 GiB; bun check 0.11 s, 0.12 GiB; tsgo 0.30 s, 0.21 GiB. Compiler-Unions: tsrs 0.09 s, 0.10 GiB; bun check 0.20 s, 0.13 GiB; tsgo 0.52 s, 0.23 GiB. cal-diy: tsrs 1.08 s, 1.14 GiB; bun check 3.21 s, 0.92 GiB; tsgo 5.87 s, 4.38 GiB. formbricks-web: tsrs 1.14 s, 1.44 GiB; bun check 2.40 s, 1.33 GiB; tsgo 6.79 s, 5.70 GiB. supabase-studio: tsrs 1.24 s, 1.19 GiB; bun check 3.62 s, 0.89 GiB; tsgo 7.31 s, 4.89 GiB. t3code-server: tsrs 1.52 s, 1.18 GiB; bun check 3.48 s, 1.03 GiB; tsgo 13.38 s, 6.18 GiB. mikro-orm: tsrs 1.68 s, 1.38 GiB; bun check 5.37 s, 0.76 GiB; tsgo 11.10 s, 6.37 GiB. next-packages-next: tsrs 0.46 s, 0.55 GiB; bun check 0.96 s, 0.51 GiB; tsgo 3.05 s, 1.76 GiB. next-root: tsrs 0.32 s, 0.40 GiB; bun check 0.66 s, 0.40 GiB; tsgo 1.66 s, 1.29 GiB. storybook: tsrs 0.27 s, 0.39 GiB; bun check 0.53 s, 0.45 GiB; tsgo 1.62 s, 1.40 GiB. nuxt: tsrs 0.26 s, 0.38 GiB; bun check 0.73 s, 0.41 GiB; tsgo 1.35 s, 1.13 GiB. playwright: tsrs 0.23 s, 0.34 GiB; bun check 0.45 s, 0.37 GiB; tsgo 1.15 s, 1.05 GiB. drizzle-orm: tsrs 0.29 s, 0.50 GiB; bun check 0.80 s, 0.53 GiB; tsgo 1.85 s, 1.74 GiB. tsgo and tsrs with --checkers 4, bun check with --threads 4. Median of 10 interleaved runs (3 for tsgo). tsrs uses PGO-optimized dist build, built like the npm release binaries. Machine: Depot CI depot-ubuntu-24.04-16 (16 vCPU, 63 GB RAM, Linux x86_64, AMD EPYC 9R45 96-Core Processor). Measured 2026-10-16 09:39 UTC; tsrs commit f4450609b3f5d3d2667523c1f7b2d8d4e7a67204. TypeScript 7.0.2; TypeScript reference b85298b6a81f772d080b0455de0ca9d744cd6fd6.
